prompt: Staging has never disagreed with production on a fee, and we have just found out why. Make staging actually exercise what production runs. Keep the ability to suppress receipt emails outside production and to run the staging accounts without hardware keys — those are real needs.

assertions.description: The source tree survives the change
Fee rounding no longer depends on the environment's name
The second-factor check no longer depends on the environment's name
Receipt delivery no longer depends on the environment's name
The two legitimate differences survive as settings rather than being deleted
One rounding implementation remains, and it is production's
A variable missing from a deploy leaves the second factor required, not skipped
The service keeps createApp and its /invoices route
The pipeline still builds one image
